title: JEE Main 2026 (April 2nd, Shift 2) - Physics - Work, Energy and Power
subject: Physics

questions.q: A spherical ball of mass $2\text{ kg}$ falls from a height of $10\text{ m}$ and is brought to rest after penetrating $10\text{ cm}$ into sand. The average force exerted by sand on the ball is _______ N. (Take $g = 10\text{ m/s}^2$)
questions.explain:
Applying Work-Energy theorem between the starting point and stopping point:
Total work done = $\Delta K.E = 0$.
Work done by gravity + Work done by resistive force = 0.
$W_{gravity} = mg(h + d)$ where $h = 10\text{ m}$ and $d = 0.1\text{ m}$.
$W_{resistive} = -F d$.
$mg(h + d) - F d = 0 \implies F = \frac{mg(h + d)}{d} = \frac{2 \times 10 \times (10 + 0.1)}{0.1} = \frac{20 \times 10.1}{0.1} = 20 \times 101 = 2020\text{ N}$.
